metric_contract.quantile: original run P99; DAG aggregate uses linear interpolation at (n-1)*0.99
metric_contract.memory: each rank budget_peak_bytes; includes reserved KV and safety/external budgets; no logical KV addition
metric_contract.output_tokens: actual token_times_ms inside chosen interval; never cohort final token totals
metric_contract.task_makespan: last node output, excluding subsequent resource drain
metric_contract.sample_policy: declared minimum applies per assessment and each requested latency metric
metric_contract.headroom: upper:1-actual/limit; lower:actual/limit-1; unitless; zero limits have no ratio

limitations: fixed KV pool; allocator fragmentation is not simulated
prefill-first admission; pressure drains active requests before recovery

warmup.cache_effect: none; measured run starts with empty KV
